label: Display-only no-lump outline gate (does not change served weights)
disclaimer: Research demo. Not for clinical use. Display option only.

selection.rule: Hide outline when peak soft-mask value is below a threshold. Chosen to clear the most normal false outlines on validation without dropping lesion Dice by more than 0.01.

busbra.plain_summary: Lump-only Dice got worse (0.714 → 0.653; drop 0.061). This set has no normal (no-lump) scans, so false-outline rate does not apply. AUC is unchanged (the display gate does not touch the class score).

breast.plain_summary: Lump-only Dice got worse (0.629 → 0.573; drop 0.056). False outlines on normal scans: 2/4 → 2/4. AUC is unchanged (the display gate does not touch the class score).

plain_summary: Hide the outline when the model’s strongest outline pixel is below 0.960 (chosen on BUSI validation). Default on. Test lesion Dice drop within 0.01; toggle defaults on.
plain_summary_external: Outside sets re-scored with the same display-only gate (peak soft-mask < 0.96). Raw = without gate; with no-lump gate = outline hidden when peak is low. AUC unchanged. BUSI held-out numbers were not changed.
